items.title: Announcing Rust 1.99.1
items.blurb: The Rust team has published a new point release of Rust, 1.99.1. Rust is a programming language that is empowering everyone to build reliable and efficient software.

items.title: What agents mean for Rust (and vice versa)
Learned Index Lab: Replacing B-Trees with streaming linear models in pure Rust (-99% RAM, 3x faster)
items.blurb: Instead of pointer-chasing through B-Tree node hierarchies, this index models the key distribution using streaming piecewise linear regression with strict epsilon error bounds.
